correctness.rationale: The complement of a successful seed set contains no stable nonadopter set. In width-two ladders an obstructing component either has a full adjacent-rung square, a full endpoint rung or a vacant path connecting both ends. Recording rung-vacancy mask and left-connected mask gives seven legal states; direct rational matrix inversion yields the stated generating function. Coefficientwise dominant y-exponent extraction yields sharp minimum seeds and their multiplicities, and the unique dominant z-pole at y=1 yields the asymptotic. Independently simulated exact two-neighbor process for n=2..8, checked n=9 count and verified rational transfer generating function coefficients n=1..10.
